split: Latest archive season test; preceding season calibration split by match date; preceding season validation; earlier seasons training
population: IPL regulation T20; excludes revised/shortened/ambiguous matches
interval: 80% marginal split conformal per over (headline) plus a conservative match-block simultaneous band
reliability: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW from model disagreement, player history and matchup sample; cut points are validation quantiles; HIGH withheld unless validation error ordering is monotone
venue_identity: locality suffixes and punctuation collapsed; reviewed renames in configs/venue_aliases.csv
